description: This file defines the TcpConnector class which implements network connection logic for TCP communication, including connection establishment, port parsing, and data handling.

classes.name: TcpConnector
classes.description: Implements TCP connection handling, including connection setup, port parsing, and data transmission.

classes.name: InvalidTcpPort
classes.description: Custom exception class for invalid TCP port formats.

methods.name: TcpConnector
methods.description: Constructor initializing hostname and port from string input.
